objective: Decide whether to build a mid-season coverage review for small-scale growers before the next renewal cycle
title: Growers decide coverage from a static plan the agent never revisits

quotes.text: We renew the same thing every year because nobody asks what changed.
My agent has not called since the hail claim.
Growers told us the plan review happens once, at signing, and never again.
Carriers are re-pricing mid-season for the first time in a decade.

themes.name: Coverage drifts from risk
themes.insight: The plan is written once and the farm changes every season.

themes.name: Silence after the claim
themes.insight: Contact stops when the claim closes.

competitiveGaps.text: Peer carriers offer a mid-season review call

requirements.text: The grower sees the plan re-read against the season that just ended before renewal.
requirements.tierRationale: maps to thesis; two independent origins; primary persona

requirements.text: The agent receives a prompt when a claim closes without a follow-up call.
The grower compares two coverage options side by side.
requirements.tierRationale: typed HYPOTHESIS: carried as a bet

bet.statement: A side-by-side comparison changes the renewal decision.
bet.test: Show two quotes to five growers before build and record the decision.
bet.conditionWhereAlternativeWins: A single recommended option wins if the growers ignore the second column.

requirements.text: The plan review renders before the quote on a rural mobile connection.
requirements.tierRationale: maps to thesis; two independent origins; primary persona

acceptanceTests.then: the prior season review appears before the quote

thesis.statement: The deciding grower renews a plan nobody re-reads, so the product re-reads it for her before renewal. Approve a mid-season coverage review for the next renewal cycle.
thesis.decisionRequested: Approve the mid-season coverage review for the next renewal cycle
thesis.whatItDoes: Re-reads the plan against the season that just ended and surfaces the change before the quote

story.user: A small-scale grower renews the same policy every year.
story.need: She needs the plan to change when her risk changes.
story.insight: Growers decide coverage from a static plan the agent never revisits.

whyNow.statement: Carriers now re-price mid-season, so a static plan leaves the grower exposed between renewals.

jobStories.iWantTo: see what changed on my farm since last season
jobStories.soICan: decide coverage from this year, not last year

jobStories.iWantTo: know which growers I have not called
jobStories.soICan: reach them before the renewal notice does

goals.text: The grower sees a season-aware plan before every renewal.
The agent feels like the first call, not the last.

nonGoals.reason: the quote is correct; the review around it is missing

nonGoals.text: Automated policy changes without an agent
nonGoals.reason: the agent approves every change in this release

assumptions.text: Growers will open a review they did not ask for.
assumptions.test: Send the review to a pilot group and record opens before build.

flows.name: Renewal review
steps: The system assembles the season summary from claims and weather records.
The grower opens the review before the quote.

businessRules: The assistant drafts the review; the agent approves before the grower sees it.

characteristics.statement: The plan review renders before the quote on a rural mobile connection.

privacy.dataMinimization: The review reads claims and weather records already held for the policy; nothing new is collected.

register.mitigation: route aged items to the agency manager

rollout.killCriteria: renewal abandonment rises in the pilot
